title: Docs: Add Python snippet to EVENTS_SCHEMA.md
body: Add a short Python example showing how to read events.v0.3.ndjson (line-by-line), filter by run_id, and build a Pandas DataFrame. Reference canonical tag "nexos/events@0.3" and fields (seq, ts, plugin.command, exit_code, dur_ms). Ensure snippet includes utf-8 handling and robust JSON parsing with fallback for empty lines. Acceptance: example present in docs/EVENTS_SCHEMA.md; verified by a quick smoke in CI logs/docs build.
